# Your own second brain

This is the template a second brain is made from: a private GitHub repo of plain notes that your AI agents work from, so they know where each of your projects got to. It's free, from [AnIdeaLab](https://anidealab.com), and there's nothing to install.

## Make yours
Three steps, about ten minutes, and a phone will do.

1. **Get a Claude Pro plan,** or above: [claude.com/pricing](https://claude.com/pricing). Your agent is Claude, and working in a brain needs a paid plan. If you have one already, go on to step 2.
2. **[Make your brain](https://github.com/new?template_owner=AnIdeaLab&template_name=second-brain&name=my-brain&visibility=private).** Sign in to GitHub, or make a free account, then press "Create repository". Leave it set to Private. The green "Use this template" button on this page does the same; choose Private there.
3. **Send your first message.** Open [claude.ai/code](https://claude.ai/code). If it asks, connect GitHub and let it see `my-brain`. Start a session with `my-brain` selected, and send this:

   ```
   This is my new second brain. Read CLAUDE.md and get me set up.
   ```

It asks you a few questions and sets everything up from there. Every chat after that starts the same way: a new session with `my-brain` selected.

The same steps, with tutorials for your first days, are at [anidealab.com/second-brain](https://anidealab.com/second-brain), where you can also have AnIdeaLab set your brain up for you.

## What you get
- **A core page** every agent reads first: what the brain is, and how you like agents to work.
- **Skills:** how-tos your agents follow for common jobs, from building a website to writing a proposal.
- **A knowledge library:** a shelf each for your projects, decisions, ideas, tasks and people, which fills up as you use it.
- **On your computer, if you like:** your first chat offers two extras, a few minutes each. One lets your agents run jobs on your PC or Mac, and the other is Obsidian, a free app that shows your brain as a map.

What's below this page is a new brain as it starts: the page you'll see in your own copy is its front door, [README.md](../README.md). This page isn't in your copy: it goes when your brain starts.

The kit this comes from, how it works and its terms of use: [AnIdeaLab/brain-kit](https://github.com/AnIdeaLab/brain-kit).
